items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And my twin brother, we both had whooping cough, and he didn’t survive longer than 6 months.

ctx.x: Elvin, if we can begin by you stating your full name and when you were born.

Elvin Jones: My name is Elvin Ray Jones. I was born in Pontiac, Michigan in 1927; as one half of a twin, I was a twin! (chuckles). And my twin brother, we both had whooping cough, and he didn’t survive longer than 6 months. You know, I can remember the funeral and everything. Cause I used to tell my mother, I’d say “That little casket was right there!” and I’d point it out to her and she’d say, “That’s right.” (chuckles).
Anthony Brown: Wow, so you say in about 6 months—he passed at about 6 months old?
